title: 2026 ACC HFpEF pathway: new consensus draft records
summary: Selected SGLT2 and nonsteroidal-MRA pathway records have been added alongside, rather than replacing, the 2022 formal US guideline grades. The consensus is not assigned a COR or LOE. Indexed primary publisher text was checked; clinical verification remains pending.

title: 2026 ESC HF guideline: separate society-specific grades
summary: Selected all-EF SGLT2/MRA and conditional HFpEF RAS-therapy recommendations retain their original ESC class and level. They do not silently change the 2022 US grades. Direct publisher access was restricted; independent source and clinical review remain required.

title: KDIGO 2027 CKD medication update is a public-review draft
summary: The official index advertises public review through November 4, 2026. Sage retains the 2024 final guideline; draft content does not replace active recommendations.

title: CDC COVID-19 schedule needs source-date review
summary: The linked page’s narrative and table-date metadata are inconsistent. Sage links the source and withholds automatic COVID dose scheduling.

title: VA formulary snapshot has a separate refresh date
summary: The downloaded VA refresh metadata reports October 29, 2026. Weekly monitoring watches drug rows, document links and refresh metadata; changes require review before a new snapshot is committed.
